entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is admitted to the petitioner that Sitaram, the alleged transferor had instituted a Suit bearing number 233 of 1977 for cancellation of sale deed in the court of Munsif Basti and the said suit was decreed.
The petitioner filed an appeal against the same which too was dismissed.
Thereafter, the matter is pending in Second Appeal No. 524 of 2010 before this Court at the behest of the petitioner.

Although, an interim order is operating therein in favour of the petitioner restraining the plaintiff of the suit from interfering in the possession of the petitioner but the net result of the litigation held so far is that the sale deed in favour of the petitioner stands cancelled.

3. The Special Land Acquisition Officer has supplied written instructions dated 20.2.2025 and wherein the stand taken is that in view of pendency of litigation between the petitioner and his alleged vendor, Second Appeal No. 524 of 2010, the compensation amount has not been paid to the petitioner.

4. Sri P.N. Rai, learned counsel for the respondent no. 1 has placed the award of Special Land Acquisition Officer dated 20.01.2024.
5.
We find no fault in the stand taken by the Special Land Acquisition Officer in this behalf.

As noted above, the second appeal of the petitioner is still pending and as such unless the same is allowed and the sale deed in favour of the petitioner is held to be valid, he would not be entitled for compensation.

At this stage, therefore, we decline to issue any direction but leave it open to the petitioner to stake claim for compensation in case, ultimately in the pending litigation the sale in his favour is held to be valid.
6. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
